purpose: Define OS/process environment variables as explicit optional configuration/secret bindings rather than canonical configuration authority.

topics.name: Environment Variable Binding
topics.purpose: Define OS/process environment variables as explicit optional configuration/secret bindings rather than canonical configuration authority.

semantics.binding_rule: Variable name maps explicitly to exact config/secret field identity.
semantics.parse_rule: String value parsing/type conversion is explicit.
semantics.missing_rule: Missing required variable fails according to exact config profile.
semantics.secret_rule: Secret-valued bindings use secret refs/redaction semantics.
semantics.canonical_rule: Environment variable existence never becomes canonical definition.
semantics.authority_rule: Process environment cannot silently grant permissions.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: any matching env var overrides config
